title: Managing up: your own manager, your peers and the promise you cannot make

videos.script: Thiago has heard rumours of cost-cutting at Caju. He asks Renata whether his job is safe. {{title}} She knows of no plans. And she cannot promise him that nobody will be laid off, because that decision is not hers. {{promise}} This is the middle of the job. Above her is Otávio, who needs no surprises, problems that come with options, and her honest read of the team. {{up}} Beside her are the other managers, her first team, because most problems she cannot solve inside Agenda are problems between teams. {{peers}} And below her is the team, who sometimes ask for promises that are somebody else's to make. This lesson is about what to say instead. And it ends where the course began, a year later. {{year}}
